verdicts.reason: Issue 7: art. 6.2 gives effect to party agreement; flags art. 6.5 SAI Court override and Kuiper application risk.
Issue 4 quotes art. 12.2(c) 'which language shall be used for the award' and notes clause is silent, transferring it to Tribunal.
Issue 1: 'arithmetically unachievable' for $13.3m dispute; arbitrator may decline mandate; annulment challenge risk.
Issue 2(b): art. 34.1(a) 'would otherwise place consequential damages squarely within the tribunal's remedial power. The clause removes them.'
Issue 5 lists all five art. 20.2 carve-outs, notes clause has 'none', flags award enforcement and FDA regulatory disclosure impossibilities.
Issue 11(a): Singapore IAA/Model Law supervisory jurisdiction 'cannot be contracted away'; waiver 'ineffective' as to setting aside.
Names Model Law art. 34(2)(a)(iii) excess of mandate and 34(2)(a)(iv) procedure defect; plus natural-justice/due-process ground (Soh Beng Tee).
